V-CB-T-001.verification: Verify Secure Boot is enabled and boot chain is cryptographically verified

V-CB-T-002.verification: Verify firmware readback protection level (RDP1/RDP2 or equivalent) is set

V-CB-T-003.verification: Verify chip provenance — confirm sourced from authorized distributor

V-CB-I-001.verification: Verify side-channel countermeasures are implemented (power analysis, timing)

V-CB-I-002.verification: Verify hardware key storage — confirm cryptographic keys are bound to chip and non-extractable

V-CB-E-001.verification: Verify JTAG/SWD interface is locked via OTP/fuse in production units

V-CB-E-002.verification: Verify full debug disable (RDP2 or equivalent) is applied in production

V-CB-SCA-001.verification: Side-channel power analysis test (SPA/DPA) — verify no key-correlated power signature is present under differential power analysis

V-CB-SCA-002.verification: Electromagnetic emission analysis — verify no key-correlated EM signal is detectable with standard near-field probe at 10cm

V-CB-SCA-003.verification: Timing attack test — verify cryptographic operations complete in constant time independent of key or data values

V-CB-SCA-004.verification: PCB inspection — verify security-critical bus traces (CPU↔TPM, CPU↔Secure Element, CPU↔Flash) are covered by potting or conformal coating; no test points accessible
